snippet.title: ChonkBlocker — Official Gameplay Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Build chains. Detonate power gems. Bury your rivals.

ChonkBlocker is a fast, comeback-heavy puzzle battler with online and local multiplayer, daily and weekly challenges, global leaderboards, eight fighters, and cross-platform desktop play.

Windows • macOS • Linux

https://chonkblocker.com
